question: Among customers who transacted at gas stations in the Czech Republic, which segment—SME, LAM, or KAM—showed the highest percentage increase in consumption between 2012 and 2013? Return the segment name and its percentage increase.

prediction.sql:
WITH GasStationCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001 AS CustomerID, c.XCL_002 AS Segment
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        gsc.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Sum2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Sum2013
    FROM GasStationCustomers gsc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON gsc.CustomerID = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' OR ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY gsc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    CAST((Sum2013 - Sum2012) AS REAL) * 100 / Sum2012 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM SegmentConsumption
WHERE Sum2012 > 0
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001 AS CustomerID, c.XCL_002 AS Segment
    FROM customers c

SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        gsc.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Sum2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS Sum2013
    FROM GasStationCustomers gsc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON gsc.CustomerID = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' OR ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY gsc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    CAST((Sum2013 - Sum2012) AS REAL) * 100 / Sum2012 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM SegmentConsumption
WHERE Sum2012 > 0
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH czech_stations AS (
    SELECT gs.XCL_004 AS station_id
    FROM gasstations gs
    WHERE gs.XCL_007 = 'Czech Republic'
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id, c.XCL_003 AS segment
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        cseg.segment,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01' THEN 2012
            WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2013-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01' THEN 2013
        END AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN czech_stations cs ON t.XCL_014 = cs.station_id
    JOIN customer_segments cseg ON t.XCL_013 = cseg.customer_id
    WHERE t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY cseg.segment, 
             CASE 
                 WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01' THEN 2012
                 WHEN t.XCL_011 >= '2013-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2014-01-01' THEN 2013
             END
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        seg2012.segment,
        ((seg2013.total_consumption - seg2012.total_consumption) / seg2012.total_consumption) * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM yearly_consumption seg2012
    JOIN yearly_consumption seg2013 
        ON seg2012.segment = seg2013.segment
    WHERE seg2012.year = 2012 
      AND seg2013.year = 2013
      AND seg2012.total_consumption > 0
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    pct_increase
FROM segment_growth
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
